title: docs(cli): fix API key env claim, add staging line
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fix README: polli never read `POLLINATIONS_API_KEY`; one-off runs use `--key`
- Adds the `POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging` login line to the polli skill (follow-up to #15877)

gist.headline: The right key for the door
gist.blurb: Polli’s instructions now point to the key that actually works. There’s a staging login line, too, for anyone testing before heading into the garden.
gist.summary: Corrected the polli CLI README to use `--key` for one-off runs instead of the unsupported `POLLINATIONS_API_KEY` variable, and added `POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging` login guidance to its skill file.
gist.impact: CLI users can supply a key with `--key` for one-off runs and follow the documented `POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging` login line when testing against staging.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the polli CLI as a friendly retro terminal, with a small key labeled `--key` and a path to a staging garden. Polli checks the directions while code-plants grow beside the screen; no separate CLI mascot is indicated.
